name: whats-loaded-mcp
description: Shows what is consuming your agent's context window before a session starts.
long_description: Reads the agent config surface on disk and reports what loads before the first message: always-loaded skill descriptions ranked by token cost, skills installed more than once under different names, CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md sizes including files their @import lines pull in, and every MCP server configured across clients. Read-only by construction: no child processes, no network, and no filesystem path is ever built from model input.

project_root.title: Project directory
project_root.description: Directory treated as the project for project-scoped skills, memory files and .mcp.json. Defaults to the server's working directory.
